purpose: Separate global source coverage, role-spine evidence and specialist framework evidence for the current thin-domain queue before SQL regeneration.

scope.reconciled_count_note: The repository contains 42 thin-queue rows. Forty-one have thin overlay additions and are the actual unpopulated gaps. D003 is a reconciliation row with five existing source-backed global role records and no additional overlay row.

interpretation.taxonomy_spine: ESCO, O*NET, ISCO and WEF provide normalized occupation, skill and trend vocabulary. They do not prove Nigerian licensing, demand or local practice requirements.
interpretation.specialist_framework: A specialist framework is a professional, regulatory, sector or occupational standard that names practice competencies, role expectations, tools, assessments or credentials. Its jurisdiction and evidence type must remain visible.
interpretation.thin_overlay: Thin overlays are additional domain-role rows assembled for the gap queue. Their fields remain reviewable and are not promoted into SQL by this audit.
interpretation.credential_rule: Only a source that explicitly establishes registration, examination, certification, licence or credential is eligible for a certification field.
